shortDescription: Commander, House Ijori are swarming the defences. Get your 'Mechs up and firing and take them down. Captain Stewart's tanks will be beside you and I don't want to see a company of dead tankers at the end of this.
longDescription: Time to mount up, Warrior House Ijori are out for revenge.
missionSuccessStatementOverride: Nicely done, Commander, that was a tough assignment.
badFaithStatementOverride: You failed when we needed you most.
goodFaithStatementOverride: That was a hard battle, I don't disrespect you for your failure.
